recent.text: POSTGAME "We played good in the neutral zone, denied a lot of entries or made it hard on them on the entries, played with a lot of pace in the D zone, won a lot of battles." @utahmammoth André Tourigny on the penalty kill https://t.co/049PCC3U6b
recent.author: Utah Mammoth PR

recent.text: POSTGAME "When we were forechecking, we were forechecking as a group of five. It wasn't just the forwards or the D. Everyone was connected and that's what makes us successful and a hard team to play against." @utahmammoth Lawson Crouse on playing connected https://t.co/fyIVYAQLaZ
recent.author: Utah Mammoth PR
